collection.description: Deep in the mangroves there is a pool so still and dark that it looks like a second sky.

ask.text:
Deep in the mangroves there is a pool so still and dark that it looks like a second sky. The fishers avoid it, because anything that falls into it comes out twice: a dropped spear, a fish, once a whole canoe, which is why the village has two canoes with exactly the same crack in the prow. Nobody has ever fallen in.
(Name) has been sent into the mangroves to gather crabs, and has slipped on a root, and is now hanging by one hand from a branch over the dark pool, with (his/her) feet a hand's width above the water. The branch is bending.
Should (name) let go and drop in, or hang on and shout for help?

c1o1.text: Two heads come up out of the dark pool at the same time, both gasping, both with the same weed in their hair. Two (name)s climb out onto the roots, look at each other, and laugh exactly the same laugh. The second takes the name (made1). The fishers aren't surprised. They are very glad it wasn't the {@chief}.

c1o2.text: {#made:Two heads|Three heads} come up out of the pool. The pool has never done that before. {#made:Two|Three} identical (name)s sit on the mangrove roots, dripping, staring at each other, and then {#made:both|all three}, at once, say, "Well, this is going to be complicated." {#made:The new one takes the name (made1), and they bring home twice the crabs|The two new ones take the names (made1) and (made2), and bring home three times the crabs}.

c1.text: (Name) lets go. The water is cold, and so dark (he/she) can't see (his/her) own hands. (He/She) kicks up towards the light, and feels someone else kicking beside (him/her)...

c2o1.text: The fishers come running and pull (name) back onto the roots. On the way up, one of (his/her) sandals falls off into the pool, and two sandals float to the surface, exactly alike. (Name) now has three sandals, which is one more than (he/she) needs, and keeps the spare as a reminder.

c2o2.text: The fishers pull (name) out before (he/she) falls in, but (his/her) toes have touched the water. And out of the pool, a moment later, climbs someone with (name)'s face, (name)'s hair, and nothing else of (name) at all: different likes, different dislikes, a different laugh. "Only the toes went in," the fishers say. "So only the outside came out." The newcomer takes the name (made1).

text_only.reason: the word in the owner's story; what changes in the game is the ending's own EFFECT line (the ledger), so this word alone changes nothing

c2.text: (Name) hangs on with both hands and shouts until (his/her) throat hurts. The branch bends lower, and lower, and (his/her) toes touch the black water...
